rows.jyutping: lau4 dai1 sam1 haak1 jan3 zoeng6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something leaves a lasting impression.

example.english: That film continues to etch a deep impression on me.
example.traditional: 嗰套電影到而家仲喺我心入面留低深刻印象。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 din6 jing2 dou3 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai2 ngo5 sam1 jap6 min6 lau4 dai1 sam1 haak1 jan3 zoeng6

rows.note: Use this when the impression is specifically fixed in someone's mind or memory.

example.english: The scenery from that trip continues to etch itself into my mind.
example.traditional: 嗰次旅行嘅景色一直印喺我腦海。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 leoi5 hang4 ge3 ging2 sik1 jat1 zik6 jan3 hai2 ngo5 nou5 hoi2

rows.note: Use this technical term when acid or another corrosive substance cuts a pattern into a surface.

example.english: The workshop uses acid to etch patterns onto metal sheets.
example.traditional: 工場用酸液喺金屬片上蝕刻花紋。
example.jyutping: gung1 coeng4 jung6 syun1 jik6 hai2 gam1 suk6 pin3 soeng6 sik6 hak1 faa1 man4
